contexts.text: Observe the rites of the Church holily.
He observed the errors and perverted things. Signified, Explained.
But those in the faith of charity observe the goods...
He has observed My ordinances... () = by continual revelations from Himself... Ordinances = all things of the Word in general... AC 3382:3, Illustrated.
This a man knows and observes, although not instructed by any knowledge...
Observation. Signified, Explained.
This is worthy to be observed.
This difference has not been observed in what precedes.
To keep, or observe, = to do; for by doing they are observed.
The things which are to be altogether observed and done (in these chapters). Enumerated.
Christian Spirits were present, and observed...
It was then observed that...
Which they believed were to be holily observed.
Observe and repent () = that they should attend to these things, and vivify their dead worship.
Thou hast observed My Word () = that they live according to the Lord's Precepts in His Word.
They could observe every thing... and whatever they observe they strive to turn to their own good...
They could observe that...
Which have often been observed by me.
I have observed that...
It was now observed...
There was given a perception of what was to be observed...
He supposed that no one had observed; but all could observe the hypocrisy and deceit; which is given to almost every man...
(Charles XII) thought that no one in the world could observe; nor did he want it to be observed...
To observe, and to keep, = to perceive, will, and do according to it.

To observe = attention, such as is with those who are in the spiritual affection of truth; for when these read the Word, they do not see it from the doctrine of the Church where they were born... for they want to be illustrated, and to see truths within themselves, and not from others...
To observe My Word = to make of the life truths from the Word; for to observe truths or precepts = not only to know and apperceive them; but also to will and do, or keep them...
The life of charity is meant by... to observe the precepts, and do them ().
Occurs.
Who observe the commandments of God () = with those who live the life of faith which is charity. Explained.
As a leopard upon the way will I observe ()... To observe = the intention to pervert.
